text.body: ॥ medhādakṣiṇāmūrti mantravarṇapadastutiḥ ।। omityekākṣaraṃ brahma vyāharanti trayaśśikhāḥ । tasmai tārātmane medhādakṣiṇāmūrtaye namaḥ ॥ 1 natvāyaṃ munayassarve paraṃ yānti durāsadam । nakārarūpiṇe medhādakṣiṇāmūrtaye namaḥ ॥ 2 mohajālavinirmukto brahmavidyāti yatpadam । mokārarūpiṇe medhādakṣiṇāmūrtaye namaḥ ॥ 3 bhavamāśritya yaṃ vidvān nabhavohyabhavatparaḥ । bhakārarūpiṇe medhādakṣiṇāmūrtaye namaḥ ॥ 4 gaganākāravaddhāntamanubhātyakhilaṃ jagat । gakārarūpiṇe medhādakṣiṇāmūrtaye namaḥ ॥ 5 vaṭamūlanivāso yo lokānāṃ prabhuravyayaḥ । vakārarūpiṇe ... ॥ 6 tejobhiryasya sūryo'sau kālaklṛptikaro bhavet । tekāra rūpiṇe ...॥ 7 dakṣatripurasaṃhāre yaḥ kālaviṣabhañjane । dakārarūpiṇe ... ॥ 8 kṣipraṃ bhavati vāksiddhiryannāmasmaraṇānnṛṇām । kṣikārarūpiṇe ... ॥ 9 ṇākāravācyo yassuptaṃ sandīpayati meṃ manaḥ । ṇākārarūpiṇe ...॥ 10 mūrtayohyaṣṭadhā yasya jagajjanmādikāraṇam । mūkārarūpiṇe ... ॥ 11 tattvaṃ brahmāsi paramamiti yadgurubodhitaḥ । sarephatātmaneme ....॥ 12 yeyaṃ viditvā brahmādyā ṛṣayo yānti nivṛtim । yekārarūpiṇe ... ॥ 13 mahatāṃ devamityāhurnigamāgamayośiśavaḥ । nakārarūpiṇe ... ॥ 14 sarvasya jagatohyantarbahiryo vyāpya saṃsthitā। makārarūpiṇe ...॥ 15 tvameva jagatassākṣī sṛṣṭisthityantakāraṇam । mekārarūpiṇe ...॥ 16 dāmeti dhātṛsṛṣṭeryatkāraṇaṃ kāryamucyate । dhāṅkārarūpiṇe 17 prakṛteryatparaṃ dhyātvā tādātmyaṃ yāti vai muniḥ। prakārarūpiṇe ... ॥ 18 jñāninoyamupāsyanti tatvātītaṃ cidātmakam । jñākārarūpiṇe ...॥ 19 prajñā sajāyate yasya dhyānanāmārcanādibhiḥ prakārapiṇe ... ॥ 20 yasyasmaraṇamātreṇa naro muktassabandhanāt । yakārarūpiṇe ... ॥ 21 chaveryagnendriyāṇyāpurviṣayeṣviha jāḍyatām । ukārarūpiṇe ...॥ 22 svāntevidāṃ jaḍānāṃ yo dūre tiṣṭhati cinmayaḥ। svākārarūpiṇe ...॥ 23 hāraprāyaphaṇīndrāya sarvavidyāpradāyine । hākārarūpiṇe ... ॥ 24 ॥ iti śrīmedhādakṣiṇāmūrti mantravarṇapadastutiḥ॥
